messages.subject: changing priority of arrivals
parts:
Greetings,
Is there a way of changing the priority of arrivals once they enter a particular trajectory?
S

messages.author: 0f5b7adb7e70bd8b
messages.subject: Re: [simmer-devel] changing priority of arrivals
parts:
2018-02-18 6:28 GMT+01:00 Shiwei <slende...@gmail.com>:
> Greetings,
> Is there a way of changing the priority of arrivals once they enter a
> particular trajectory?
> S
>

Yes, there is an activity called set_prioritization. You have to
provide three values: (priority, preemptible, restart). See
?set_prioritization and ?add_generator for more information about
these parameters.

Iñaki

Thanks. So I had a look at the documentation for set_prioritization. What if I want to prioritise those in queue with high priority? For example, ED staff is already seized and there are 10 patients waiting. When ED staff is done seeing her/his current patient, I want the ED staff to see the head trauma patient  who is 10th in queue rather than the patient who broke his toe who is first in queue.

Kind regards,

messages.author: 0f5b7adb7e70bd8b
messages.subject: Re: [simmer-devel] changing priority of arrivals
parts:
2018-02-22 8:38 GMT+01:00 Shiwei Huang <slende...@gmail.com>:
> Thanks. So I had a look at the documentation for set_prioritization. What if
> I want to prioritise those in queue with high priority? For example, ED
> staff is already seized and there are 10 patients waiting. When ED staff is
> done seeing her/his current patient, I want the ED staff to see the head
> trauma patient who is 10th in queue rather than the patient who broke his
> toe who is first in queue.

That's the whole point about having priorities. Arrivals are
automatically reordered by simmer based on their assigned priorities.
So the head trauma patient will be the first in line even though they
arrived in 10th position.

>
> Kind regards,
> Shiwei
>

Iñaki
